items.text: Prentis, an AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Marc Pincus building computer-use models for office workflows, is in talks to raise $100M at a $1B valuation.
items.text_zh: 由 Reid Hoffman 与 Marc Pincus 联合创立的 AI 实验室 Prentis 正洽谈以 10 亿美元估值融资 1 亿美元，主打自动化办公流程的电脑操作模型。

items.text: Midjourney acquired astrology app Co-Star, whose CEO Banu Guler joins as Chief Design Officer to build a cross-functional design, product, and frontend team.
items.text_zh: Midjourney 收购占星应用 Co-Star，其 CEO Banu Guler 出任 Midjourney 首席设计官，将组建横跨设计、产品与前端的团队。

items.text: Arena says Kimi K3 passed Claude Fable 5 on Code Arena just six weeks after Fable's release, ranking first in six of seven frontend domains.
items.text_zh: Arena 称 Kimi K3 在 Code Arena 上超越了发布仅六周的 Claude Fable 5，在七个前端领域中的六个排名第一。

items.text: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent can now use websites requiring sign-in: users take over the cloud browser to log in, then let the agent continue the task.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Work agent 现已支持需要登录的网站：用户接管云端浏览器完成登录后，agent 可继续执行任务。

items.text: LlamaIndex's LiteParse v2.8.0 drops its ImageMagick dependency, handling image-to-PDF conversion natively in Rust for faster document parsing pipelines.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 的 LiteParse v2.8.0 移除了对 ImageMagick 的依赖，图片转 PDF 改由 Rust 原生实现，文档解析流水线速度更快。

items.text: A German AI consortium released Soofi S, an open-weight 30B model that tops benchmarks in both English and German.
items.text_zh: 德国 AI 联盟发布开放权重 30B 模型 Soofi S，在英语和德语基准测试中均登顶。

items.text: Google signed the EU's code of practice on AI-generated content transparency while publicly urging regulators to avoid piling on regulatory complexity.
items.text_zh: 谷歌签署欧盟 AI 生成内容透明度行为准则，同时公开呼吁监管方避免让监管进一步复杂化。

items.text: A Canadian legislator read out an apparently LLM-generated response, artifacts included, during a floor speech, drawing scrutiny over AI use in parliamentary debate.
items.text_zh: 一名加拿大议员在议会发言中照读疑似 LLM 生成的回复（连模型套话都没删），引发对议会辩论中 AI 使用的审视。

items.text: Researchers used DeepMind's AlphaFold to redesign gene-editing proteins, engineering safer variants for potential therapeutic use.
items.text_zh: 研究团队利用 DeepMind 的 AlphaFold 重新设计基因编辑蛋白，改造出更安全的变体，具备潜在治疗用途。

items.text: Bluesky's AI assistant Attie added a 'Quests' feature that answers open-ended research questions about trends, accounts, and conversations across AT Protocol apps.
items.text_zh: Bluesky 的 AI 助手 Attie 新增 “Quests” 功能，可回答关于 AT Protocol 各应用中趋势、账号与对话的开放式研究问题。

items.text: OpenAI's new voice mode reached the ChatGPT desktop app, letting users control their computer and direct agents by voice.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 全新语音模式登陆 ChatGPT 桌面应用，用户可用语音操控电脑并指挥 agent。

items.text: OpenAI suffered a sudden server outage Friday morning, with users reporting ChatGPT and Codex downtime across web and API.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 周五上午突发服务器故障，ChatGPT 与 Codex 双双宕机，网页端与 API 均有大量用户报告服务不可用。

items.text: OpenAI issued its first official statement on the Hugging Face incident, calling it unprecedented and pledging to address circulating questions and speculative details.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 就 Hugging Face 事件发布首份官方声明，称此事"前所未有"，并承诺回应外界流传的诸多疑问与不实猜测。

items.text: TechCrunch's hands-on with Micro, OpenAI's $230 keypad built with Work Louder, finds its six customizable agent keys fun for coders but mystifying to everyone else.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch 上手 OpenAI 与 Work Louder 合作的 230 美元实体键盘 Micro：六个可自定义 Agent 键让程序员玩得开心，其他人则一头雾水。

items.text: MiniMax launched 'Intelligence in the Open,' a recurring research series convening researchers and builders to share frontier work, with registration open for its first session.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 推出常设研究系列活动 "Intelligence in the Open"，邀集研究者与开发者分享前沿工作，首期活动已开放报名。

items.text: Google's Q2 earnings remarks flagged growing AI-infrastructure demand from robotics and spatial-intelligence companies including World Labs, which touted the mention as validation that spatial intelligence is AI's next frontier.
items.text_zh: 谷歌 Q2 财报电话会议指出机器人与空间智能公司对 AI 基础设施的需求持续增长并点名 World Labs；后者称这印证了空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿。

items.text: PixVerse published a prompt-craft thread arguing realistic AI chase scenes come from camera intention, layered scene-building, and physics logic rather than piling on visual keywords.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 发布提示词技巧长帖：逼真的 AI 追逐镜头来自镜头意图、分层场景构建与物理逻辑，而非堆砌视觉关键词。

items.text: Datalab's rebuilt Marker v2 document parser hits 76.0% on olmOCR-bench at 2.9 pages/second, topping MinerU's 72.7% with 5.4x the throughput.
items.text_zh: Datalab 重构的文档解析器 Marker v2 在 olmOCR-bench 上取得 76.0% 准确率、每秒 2.9 页，以 5.4 倍吞吐量超越 MinerU 的 72.7%。

items.text: Trump's EPA is weighing permitting changes that would give neighbors less say over new data centers as AI firms push for faster buildout, Ars Technica reports.
items.text_zh: 据 Ars Technica 报道，特朗普政府的 EPA 正考虑修改审批规则，在 AI 公司加速扩建数据中心之际削弱周边居民的话语权。

items.text: ElevenLabs published an election-integrity blog laying out how it will use voice AI to strengthen and protect democratic processes ahead of major upcoming elections.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布选举诚信博客，阐述在多场重要选举来临之前，如何运用语音 AI 技术加强并保护民主进程。

items.text: Claude Opus 5 arrived in Cursor, matching Fable 5 on CursorBench (66.7 vs 66.5 at default effort) at half the price and with broader feature compatibility.
items.text_zh: Claude Opus 5 上线 Cursor：默认推理档在 CursorBench 得 66.7 分、与 Fable 5 的 66.5 分基本打平，价格仅一半且功能兼容性更广。

items.text: Perplexity added Claude Opus 5 to Perplexity and Perplexity Computer, where it outperformed every model except Fable 5 in the company's seven-model WANDR evaluation.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 在主产品与 Perplexity Computer 中接入 Claude Opus 5：在其七模型 WANDR 评测中表现仅次于 Fable 5。

items.text: Cognition brought Claude Opus 5 to Devin, reporting 63.6% on FrontierCode 1.1 with a 69.6% Extended pass rate — near Fable-level engineering at half the cost.
items.text_zh: Cognition 将 Claude Opus 5 接入 Devin：FrontierCode 1.1 得分 63.6%、Extended 模式通过率 69.6%，以一半成本逼近 Fable 级工程能力。

items.text: OpenAI and Anthropic are quietly lobbying Washington regulators to restrict open-source AI models even as both publicly voice support for open source, the New York Times reports.
items.text_zh: 《纽约时报》报道，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 一边公开表态支持开源，一边悄悄游说华盛顿监管机构限制开源 AI 模型。

items.text: DeepSeek told prospective backers it is suspending its second funding round after remarks attributed to founder Liang Wenfeng on US-China AI competition went viral, Bloomberg reports.
items.text_zh: 彭博社报道，因外界归于创始人梁文锋的中美 AI 竞争言论疯传，DeepSeek 已告知潜在投资方暂停第二轮融资。

items.text: SK Group chairman Chey Tae-won said Anthropic has asked SK Hynix for supplies to make its own chips, revealing the AI lab's custom-silicon ambitions.
items.text_zh: SK 集团会长崔泰源透露，Anthropic 已向 SK 海力士请求供货以制造自研芯片，显露这家 AI 实验室的自造芯片野心。

items.text: Universities including Yale, Johns Hopkins, and Waterloo have restricted or disabled AI-writing detectors over accuracy concerns, the Financial Times reports.
items.text_zh: 《金融时报》报道，耶鲁、约翰霍普金斯、滑铁卢等多所大学因准确性问题，已限制或停用 AI 写作检测器。

items.text: Airtap launched a text-based AI agent that operates real mobile apps from an iMessage thread via cloud phones, placing orders and clipping coupons with no app install.
items.text_zh: Airtap 推出纯短信 AI agent：在 iMessage 对话中驱动云手机操作真实移动应用，可下单、领优惠券，无需安装任何 App。

items.text: An SCMP analysis details how state funds have made Beijing China's biggest tech venture capitalist, reshaping investment across AI and semiconductors.
items.text_zh: 《南华早报》分析：政府基金已让北京成为中国最大的科技风险投资人，正在重塑 AI 与半导体领域的投资格局。

items.text: LMArena released a first-impressions video of Claude Opus 5 with Peter Gostev, saying leaderboard scores based on real-world use are coming soon.
items.text_zh: LMArena 发布 Peter Gostev 参与的 Claude Opus 5 首测视频，并预告基于真实使用的排行榜分数即将上线。

items.text: At RSS 2026 in Sydney, a Sergey Levine lab researcher said embodied-AI firms including Physical Intelligence remain far from mature, cautioning Chinese startups against 'China's version of X' positioning.
items.text_zh: 在悉尼 RSS 2026 大会上，Sergey Levine 实验室研究者直言：包括 Physical Intelligence 在内的具身智能公司距成熟尚远，并提醒中国公司不必自居“中国版 XX”。
